subject: Fraud & Scams
title: Allen Stanford's Offshore Empire
description: A quick win: understand Allen Stanford's Offshore Empire.

hook.text: Allen Stanford sold CDs promising returns double the market rate from a tiny bank in Antigua.

buildup.text: His Stanford Financial Group managed $7 billion. He lived like royalty and was knighted.

discovery.text: The bank's miraculous returns came from new deposits, not real investments.

twist.text: Stanford used his wealth to buy political influence, making regulators hesitant to investigate.

climax.text: He was convicted of fraud in 2012 and sentenced to 110 years in prison.

punchline.text: A knighthood can't outrun a 110-year sentence.

quiz.question: Where was Allen Stanford's fraudulent bank based?
